## Signal type

- [ ] pain — something is broken or blocking
- [ ] wish — a capability I want that does not exist
- [ ] confusion — I could not find or understand something
- [ ] comparison — how this compares to another tool or approach
- [ ] intent — I would adopt, pay, or contribute if X
- [ ] praise — positive signal worth recording
